CHAPTER XVIII
DEDUCTION OF INCOME TAX FROM RENT, LEASE RENT OR OTHER PAYMENT
PAID BY ANY PERSON OR PARTNERSHIP FOR THE USE OR OCCUPATION OF
ANY LAND OR BUILDING OTHER THAN FOR RESIDENTIAL PURPOSES
155. Every person or partnership paying any rent, lease
rent  or  other  payment  for  the  use  or  occupation  otherwise
than as a residence, of any specified land or building, shall
deduct at the time of the payment of such rent, lease rent or
other payment, income tax at the rate of ten per centum of
such rent, lease rent or other payment.
